adrs.summary: Only the backend holds cluster credentials

adrs.proof: ✓ non-backend containers' automountServiceAccountToken read from the pod spec: 2 | ✓ pods governed and past warm-up: 3/3 pod(s) governed (tiers backend, database, frontend), youngest 457s vs warm-up 210s, sensor rows in window: 3

adrs.title: Images are immutable at runtime; nothing is installed after build
adrs.proof: ✓ all pods governed and past warm-up: 3/3 pod(s) governed (tiers backend, database, frontend), youngest 457s vs warm-up 210s, sensor rows in window: 3 | ✓ containers' root filesystem mode and volume mounts read from the pod spec: 3 | findings: 1 counted, 0 discounted

findings.decision_broken: a writable volume overlays an image path
findings.fix: mount volumes read-only, or outside the image's directories (/usr, /bin, /lib, /opt, /app, /etc)

adrs.summary: Every workload is classified and bound
adrs.title: Every workload is classified and bound to its tier profile; an unrecognised one is quarantined
adrs.proof: ✓ pods checked at admission (tier label + profile binding): 3 [tier=backend bound=True ×1; tier=database bound=True ×1; tier=frontend bound=True ×1]

adrs.title: Workloads run as non-root
adrs.proof: ✓ containers' securityContext read from the pod spec: 3 | ✓ kubescape scan supplied (insecure capabilities / host namespaces): 1 | findings: 1 counted, 0 discounted

findings.decision_broken: the container used a Linux capability, i.e. it starts as root and drops
findings.observed: Unexpected capability used: CAP_SETUID in syscall read with PID 5696 [capability=CAP_SETUID, process=bash]
findings.fix: switch to the rootless/distroless image variant; this is an image choice, not a profile gap

adrs.summary: Detection cannot be switched off by a profile

findings.fix: accept the platform IdP's issuer and audience; fetch its JWKS from the OIDC discovery document

adrs.title: No plaintext on the wire
adrs.proof: ✗ the frontend is exposed through the platform (tailnet-exposed Service): 0 (needs ≥1) | ✗ application flows captured on the wire (Pixie): 0 (needs ≥1)

adrs.title: Metrics are served on a dedicated port, scraped only by the platform
adrs.proof: ✓ containerPort names read from the pod spec: 2 | ✓ /metrics probed on the application port: 1 [workload=commons-grid-backend status=404 ×1] | findings: 1 counted, 0 discounted

adrs.summary: Resources, probes and security context declared
adrs.title: Every workload declares its envelope: resources, probes, security context
adrs.proof: ✓ containers' resources, probes and securityContext read from the pod spec: 3

adrs.title: Images are pinned by digest, signed; no latest
adrs.proof: ✓ container images checked for @sha256 pins: 3 [pinned=True ×3] | ✓ kubescape scan supplied (image signature): 1

adrs.title: Credentials are per workload, short-lived, and never in environment variables or manifests
adrs.proof: ✓ containers' env, envFrom and volume mounts read from the pod spec: 3 | ✓ kubescape scan supplied (credentials in configuration): 1 | findings: 1 counted, 0 discounted

findings.decision_broken: a Secret is injected as an environment variable (visible to every process, child, core dump and /proc)
findings.fix: mount the Secret as a read-only file (volume or CSI secrets store), or use short-lived workload identity

adrs.title: A workload's ServiceAccount holds only the permissions its code uses; nothing is bound to default
adrs.proof: ✓ ServiceAccounts of the running pods resolved through their bindings to rules: 1 [service_account=default rules=0 ×1]

adrs.title: Workloads are unprivileged, touch no host path, load no kernel module and cannot reach the cloud metadata API
adrs.proof: ✓ containers' securityContext, capabilities and volumes read from the pod spec: 3 | ✓ the namespace's egress policy checked against the metadata API address: 1 [metadata_api_blocked=False ×1] | findings: 1 counted, 0 discounted

findings.decision_broken: egress to the cloud metadata API (169.254.169.254) is not blocked by NetworkPolicy
findings.fix: default-deny egress plus explicit allows; never an allow covering 169.254.169.254

adrs.title: A workload is reachable only through the platform's tailnet exposure of its frontend Service; it opens nothing itself
adrs.proof: ✓ Services, exposure annotations and NetworkPolicies of the namespace examined: 1 [objects=0 fronts_frontend=False tls=None ×1] | findings: 2 counted, 0 discounted

findings.decision_broken: the frontend is not exposed through the platform's tailnet
findings.fix: annotate the frontend Service: tailscale.com/expose: "true", tailscale.com/hostname: <app>, tailscale.com/tags: tag:<platform tag>

findings.decision_broken: no default-deny NetworkPolicy in the namespace
findings.fix: default-deny ingress+egress; allow tailscale-system->frontend, frontend->backend, backend->database, backend->IdP, monitoring->metrics, all->DNS
